test_title: PYST 11: Selection Post (Higher Secondary Level) - English Language (Held On 21 Jun, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in indirect speech.

Anita said, "I am happy."

options.text: Anita said that she was happy.

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• When converting from direct to indirect speech, the tense of the verb usually shifts back. For example, present tense changes to past tense.
 
• In the given sentence, "I am happy" (present tense) changes to "she was happy" (past tense) in indirect speech.
 
• The pronoun "I" in direct speech changes to "she" in the reported speech to match the subject "Anita."
 
• Using "**that**" as a conjunction is common in indirect speech to introduce the reported clause.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 3.**

 

**Correct Sentence:** *Anita said that she was happy.*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: "She was happy said Anita."** – The structure is incorrect for indirect speech. It places "said Anita" inappropriately.
 
• **Option 2: "Anita was happy she said."** – This also does not follow correct indirect speech structure and is awkwardly constructed.
 
• **Option 4: "I am happy said Anita."** – This is still direct speech and does not transform the quotation to indirect speech.
